item.title: Board of Peace will ask the UN Security Council to press Hamas to disarm
item.description: The body overseeing the U.S.-brokered ceasefire in Gaza plans to ask the United Nations Security Council to press Hamas to disarm

item.title: Libyan detention facility head known as 'Angel of Death' faces Int'l Criminal Court
item.description: Prosecutors at the International Criminal Court have told judges that the senior commander of a Libyan detention facility murdered and raped prisoners, sometimes in front of their children

item.title: Taiwan's Lai says he would tell Trump he hopes to continue arm purchases
item.description: Taiwan President Lai Ching-te says that if given the chance he would tell U.S. President Donald Trump he hopes to continue U.S. arms purchases that are essential for peace

item.title: Opposition leaders in the Bahamas demand probe after US ties politician to drug trafficking case
item.description: Opposition leaders in the Bahamas are demanding an investigation after a U.S. federal agent alleged that a suspected drug trafficker who survived a recent plane crash near Florida was rescued and found with roughly $30,000

item.title: Russia holds massive drills of its nuclear forces as Ukraine steps up its drone attacks
item.description: The Russian military has begun drills of its nuclear forces that will feature practice launches of nuclear-capable ballistic and cruise missiles

item.title: Malaysia seeks $251 million after Norway revokes permit, scuttling missile deal
item.description: Malaysia's government seeks $251 million in compensation from Kongsberg Defense & Aerospace AS after Norway revoked an export permit

item.title: Lettuce introduce you to the live frog found in this grocery store salad bag
item.description: An Australian farmer has found a live frog in a bag of lettuce
